items.text: Chicago TE Cole Kmet (knee) goes on IR for the season. At Tuesday's practice RB Kyle Monangai (toe), CB Malik Muhammad (toe) and CB Tyrique Stevenson (hip) did not practice; LB T.J. Edwards (hamstring) returned.

Seattle LT Charles Cross has a high-ankle sprain (hoped 1-2 weeks per Rapoport); Josh Jones would start. WR Rashid Shaheed (knee) missed the second half vs KC with 'positive' early returns. RB Zach Charbonnet could debut.
